title: How to replace the Dishwasher Circulation Pump
safety: Turn off power at the breaker
steps: Disconnect power at the breaker and shut off the water supply.
Remove the toe-kick panel and place a towel under the unit.
Disconnect the drain hose and water line if needed to pull the dishwasher out.
Access the pump from the bottom panel; take a photo of wiring and hose positions.
Disconnect wiring harness and loosen hose clamps.
Remove mounting fasteners and lift out the circulation pump.
Install the new pump, reattach hoses and wiring, and check seals.
Reassemble panels, restore water and power, and run a short test cycle to check for leaks.
